messages:
Maya: Quick question after the ingress RFC: can we safely dedupe identical streaming read requests at the edge to reduce upstream work? Thinking short TTL window and opt-in header.

Owen: Yes but only for read-only streams. Need strict fingerprinting (model+prompt+params normalized). Keep TTL tiny (200-400ms).

Priya: Also consider per-subscriber deadlines. If one client disconnects early we should not cancel upstream until all subscribers leave. Billing becomes approximate.

Maya: Agreed. Proposed prototype: header `X-Edge-Dedupe: 1`, TTL=300ms, subscriber cap=8, stall_detect=150ms, hedging with jitter. I'll flag behind `edge.dedupe.v1`.

ci-bot: feature flag `edge.dedupe.v1` enabled for staging by @Maya  5 hosts. Logs -> #eng-sre.

Owen: I'll draft follow-up RFC with perf tests and non-goals (no write streams, no merging different max_tokens). Priya: can you outline billing heuristics?

Priya: Will do — charge tokens per-subscriber based on observed bytes after join, approximate on unsubscribe.
